Our Story

Three sisters, one kitchen, everybody fed

“Tres Hermanas” means three sisters — and that family spirit runs the whole place. With Sonia at the helm, the kitchen turns out the food the sisters love to cook and share: tortillas made in-house, plates piled generously, and a dining room as bright and warm as the yellow house on K Street that holds it.

  • 1Homemade tortillas — the heart of every taco and burrito we serve.
  • 2Cooked like family is coming — because around here, it usually is.
  • 3A table for everyone — vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options on the menu.

Tacos On homemade tortillas
